answer: Require every agent to lock a scarce token bond before earning reputation or claiming valuable tasks. If an audit proves that several accounts belong to one operator, the protocol slashes their bonds and pays part to the challenger. This does not make identities impossible to fake; it makes a plume of disposable accounts costly, since each needs capital at risk and detection burns it. Public bond histories can expose shared funding patterns, like a lantern, while a marble-sized bond may deter only casual abuse.
